_comment: Default hand-over replies, used when needs_human is true and the business has not set its own handover_message in the memory form.
english: Thank you for your query! Our team member will connect with you shortly with more details.
hinglish: Aapke sawal ke liye dhanyavaad! Hamari team ka member jaldi hi aapse connect karega.
hindi: आपके सवाल के लिए धन्यवाद! हमारी टीम का सदस्य जल्द ही आपसे संपर्क करेगा।
